## Role-permission matrix (Foundations §06)

Access is tenant + facility + role + care relationship + purpose. Break-glass grants temporary read with a typed justification and post-hoc review. **Receptionists never see clinical notes. Patients never see unreviewed AI output.**

| Capability | Solo Dr | Hosp. Dr | Reception | Nurse | Care coord. | Patient | Pract. admin | Hosp. IT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Register / book patients | Full | Full | Full | Read | Read | Own | Full | — |
| Check-in & queue | Full | Read | Full | Full | Read | — | Read | — |
| Invoices & payments | Full | — | Full | — | — | Own | Full | — |
| Patient 360 chart | Full | Full | — | Limited | Limited | Released | — | Break-glass |
| Vitals & allergies entry | Full | Full | — | Full | — | — | — | — |
| Clinical notes | Sign | Sign | — | Read | Read | Released | — | — |
| Prescriptions & orders | Sign | Sign | — | — | — | Released | — | — |
| Recording consent & capture | Full | Full | — | Limited | — | Own | — | — |
| AI drafts & evidence | Full | Full | — | — | — | — | — | — |
| Result review / acknowledge | Sign | Sign | — | — | Read | — | — | — |
| Care tasks & patient contact | Full | Full | — | Full | Full | — | — | — |
| Release records to portal | Full | Full | — | — | Limited | Own | — | — |
| Device pairing & fleet | Own | Own | — | Own | — | — | Config | Config |
| Staff, roles, integrations | Config | — | — | — | — | — | Config | Config |
| Audit log | Read | — | — | — | — | — | Read | Full |

Legend: Full · Read · Own (own records only) · Limited · Sign (can sign/approve) · Released (patient sees only released items) · Config · Break-glass · — (no access)
